sloka: राजन्पुरुषभूतस्त्वं स्त्रीभावं न स्मरिष्यसि ।स्त्रीभूतश्च परं मासं न स्मरिष्यसि पौरुषम् ।। ७.८७.२८ ॥
transliteration: rājanpuruṣabhūtastvaṁ strībhāvaṁ na smariṣyasi ।strībhūtaśca paraṁ māsaṁ na smariṣyasi pauruṣam ।। 7.87.28 ॥

translations.english: O King, when you become a man, you will not remember your state as a woman, and when you become a woman for the next month, you will not remember your manhood.
